_comment: Agent characterId -> display name. Sourced from Riot's own public content mirror (https://valorant-api.com/v1/agents and, for individual ids, https://valorant-api.com/v1/agents/{id}), not reverse-engineered from any replay. NOT guaranteed exhaustive -- the bulk /v1/agents?isPlayableCharacter=true response is large enough that this project's fetch tooling truncates it before reaching every entry, so several agents (confirmed missing here as of 2026-09: Yoru) don't come back that way even though they're really in the API; fetching a specific agent by id (much smaller response) reliably works once you have its GUID, which is how Jett/Omen/Waylay/Reyna/Sage below were added after a real replay surfaced their ids as 'unrecognized'. Unknown characterIds fall back to the raw GUID rather than guessing -- if you hit one, the viewer's Debug info panel or an 'unrecognized agent id' note names the exact GUID to look up.
